---
title: "Whither Thee, Da Vinci?"
date: 2026-05-25
search: false
---

<p>This is a lament for the scholar, artist, genius, mad man or whatever you want to call Da Vinci. I look around and I don't see many, if any, drawing skulls and painting stoats (well), thinking above <strong>AND</strong> beyond, wearing cloaks with large beards in Italian heat or writing back to front and upside down.</p>

<p>What would Da Vinci do today? Where would he be? As Trump says: <em>I will tell you: he would be shunted out of society.</em> Left to dwindle on the side-lines as he is 'too interesting'.</p>

<p>But Da Vinci was a product of his time?! Well we live in boring times.</p>

<p>Now don't get me started on Diogenes.</p>

<br>
